subject: SOW: ramp & usage-floor restructuring — change control path
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Molina <sara@vocality.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOW: ramp & usage-floor restructuring — change control path

Sara —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As discussed, Vocality's expected ramp through Q4 increases the token run-rate and we want to lock a cleaner path for temporary throughput bursts while keeping the billing floor predictable. Attached is a proposed SOW edit (Vocality_SOW_v2.docx) that: 

- Splits Tier 2 into 2A/2B to capture burstable capacity vs committed baseline.
- Introduces a 60-day temporary top-up mechanism (change-control) that can be invoked once per quarter.
- Reframes the usage floor from a flat monthly minimum to a rolling 90-day average to reduce short-term volatility.

High-level asks for you: please confirm whether the rolling-floor approach works for accounting, and whether your procurement team prefers an amendment (change order) or a replacement exhibit. If you prefer, we can push the changes via DocuSign once legal sign-off is complete.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Vocality confirms preference on amendment vs replacement exhibit (reply by Thu EOD).
2) We share a redlines summary with legal (we'll prod in parallel).
3) Final signable package (DocuSign) with implementation window noted.

Attachment: Vocality_SOW_v2.docx (docx)

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

From: Sara Molina <sara@vocality.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vocality Contracts <contracts@vocality.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOW: ramp & usage-floor restructuring — change control path

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

1) On the rolling 90-day floor — that approach is acceptable, but our finance team asks for a short example table that shows billing under 3 usage profiles (steady, spike-then-drop, ramp). Could you provide that?
2) On the 60-day top-up — procurement prefers an amendment (change order) to the Order Form rather than replacing the exhibit. Easier to track.

I've CC'd our contracts mailbox; they want to see your legal redlines before we route internally. We'll aim to turn on our side within 3 business days after receiving redlines.

Thanks —
Sara Molina
Head of Business Ops, Vocality Labs
sara@vocality.ai

[attachment: Vocality_Req_Profile.xlsx (xlsx)]

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOW: ramp & usage-floor restructuring — redlines summary + legal ask

Jordan / Kim —

I reviewed Vocality_SOW_v2 and pulled a concise redlines_summary (attached) that maps each commercial change to the MSA clauses likely affected (billing, termination, change control). Key items: 

- Rolling 90-day floor: requires an alternate billing trigger in Exhibit A plus an example calculation appendix.
- 60-day temporary top-up: we should implement as a limited-scope Change Order template (exhibit amendment) with auto-fallback to prior commit if not exercised within 30 days of invocation.
- Tier split (2A/2B): pricing matrix updated; need a clause for transparent burst-priced tokens to avoid dispute.

Action for Legal: please confirm whether the fallback language above is acceptable. If legal prefers, we can convert the example calculation into an MSA appendix rather than an SOW exhibit.

I will loop Legal (cc'd Laura) to start redline review — Laura, can you take first pass and flag any SOC/data residency implications?

Attachment: redlines_summary_JB_KI.pdf (pdf)

Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized change-control plan + DocuSign link (VL-1943)

Sara / Contracts —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We've incorporated Vocality's preference for an amendment (change order) and added the example billing table you requested (attached inline in the SOW). Legal completed a first-pass on the redlines and authorized a change-order template with the fallback language Karthik suggested. Summary of what's in the signable package: 

- Change Order (amendment to Order Form) that adds Tier 2A/2B and the 60-day top-up mechanism.
- Exhibit A: updated billing trigger with rolling 90-day example table.
- Implementation window: changes become effective on the first day of the month following signature and apply retroactively to any mid-month top-ups during that billing cycle.

Link to sign (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/track/EnvelopeID/0a1b2c3d
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VL-1943
Drive SOW: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kqVocalitySOWv2

Kimberly will route procurement-friendly cover language to contracts if Vocality wants slightly different invoicing cadence. We can also add a 30-day notice period before any automatic fallback is enforced if you prefer more runway.

Ask: please sign the DocuSign envelope and route internally; let me know if you need a conference call with Legal on Wednesday.

Attachments included: Vocality_SOW_v2.docx, redlines_summary_JB_KI.pdf, DocuSign_Vocality_OrderForm_1943.pdf

Best —
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148
